detail: File is 3275 lines, well above the 1000-line maintainability threshold. Large files typically contain many unrelated concerns and make code review and change-isolation harder. Suggested fix: split into smaller modules by responsibility.

title: Inconsistent return statements: 3 functions mix explicit/implicit returns (L852,L868,L2705)
detail: Some functions return a value on some paths and fall off the end (returning `None` implicitly) on others. Callers that rely on the return value may receive `None` unexpectedly. Suggested fix: add an explicit `return` on all branches or refactor to raise on error paths.

title: Exception context suppressed: 6 `raise` statements without `from` (L372,L388,L395,L476,L2922,L3264)
detail: Raising a new exception inside an `except` block without `raise NewExc() from exc` discards the original traceback, making debugging harder. Suggested fix: use `raise NewExc() from exc` or `raise NewExc() from None` if suppression is intentional.

title: setattr() with constant attribute name at L2591,2592,2593
detail: Using `setattr(obj, 'literal_name', value)` provides no safety benefit over direct attribute assignment and signals that the attribute names are dynamic-but-actually-hardcoded, which misleads readers. Suggested fix: replace with direct attribute assignment `obj.attr = value`.
